title: Placeholder Probe Spec
description: Declarative spec consumed by lib/probe.sh. Maps placeholder names to ordered rule lists; first matching rule wins. Disambiguation: rules within a placeholder are evaluated in array order; on the first rule whose predicate fires (file present, regex matches, jq path resolves, glob count > 0, command exits 0 with non-empty stdout), the rule's value is emitted and remaining rules are skipped. Trust gate: 'command' rules require TRUSTED=1 at the probe_extract call site; lib/probe.sh refuses 'command' rules from project-local (untrusted) specs to prevent arbitrary execution under audit. All file paths are relative to PROJECT_DIR.

$schema.description: Optional reference to this schema for editor tooling.

$schema_version.description: Spec format version. Bump on breaking changes to rule semantics.

placeholders.description: Map of {{PLACEHOLDER_NAME}} (without braces) to its ordered rule list.

rules.description: Ordered rule list. First matching rule wins.

rule_file_regex.description: Bash ERE match against a file's content, evaluated per line. ${1} in `value` expands to capture group 1. Pattern is consumed by bash [[ =~ ]] / BASH_REMATCH — no sed metachar concerns. Bash ERE is similar to POSIX ERE but the dialect is Bash's; portability to non-Bash regex engines is not guaranteed.

pattern.description: Bash extended regex (consumed by [[ =~ ]] / BASH_REMATCH). Capture group 1 is available as ${1} in `value`.

value.description: Emitted value template. May contain ${1} (group 1) or be a static string.

rule_json_path.description: jq selector against a JSON file. Rule fires when the selector yields a non-null, non-empty string. ${value} in `value` substitutes the resolved JSON string.

file.description: JSON file path relative to PROJECT_DIR.

value.description: Emitted value template. May contain ${value} (resolved selector result) or be a static string.

rule_file_present.description: Fires if the named file exists; emits the static value.

value.description: Static value to emit on file presence.

rule_file_glob_count.description: Counts files matching each candidate glob (via `find -name`); emits the candidate value with the highest count (strictly > 0). On tie, earliest-declared wins. Leading '**/' is stripped — matching is by basename, recursive into PROJECT_DIR.

glob.description: Glob pattern (e.g. '**/*.ts'). '**/' prefix accepted; matching is by basename via `find -name`.

value.description: Value emitted when this candidate has the highest match count.

rule_command.description: Run a shell command (cwd = PROJECT_DIR), capture trimmed stdout. TRUSTED-only: lib/probe.sh refuses this rule type when probe_extract is called with TRUSTED=0 (project-local spec). Curate command rules in the template-cache copy of the spec only.

command.description: Shell command, executed via `bash -c` in PROJECT_DIR. Stdout (trimmed) is the emitted value.
